اختبرن (form VIII)
# اِخْتَبَرْنَ (iḵtabarna) /ix.ta.bar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَبَرَ (iḵtabara)
# اُخْتُبِرْنَ (uḵtubirna) /ux.tu.bir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِخْتَبَرَ (iḵtabara)
# اِخْتَبِرْنَ (iḵtabirna) /ix.ta.bir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْتَبَرَ (iḵtabara)
